extra.text: The gatehouse loses heat faster than courage. Craft a heater prototype and demonstrate it before the next frost.
Your first verified completion counts as Lamplighters civic service. Joining the guild is optional.

accept.text: Test it well. You will keep this costly heater; the watch needs a pattern it can trust.

decline.text: Understood. The watch has blankets and will make do without resentment.

in_progress.text: A working heater, please. The gate cannot come indoors for the lesson.

ready.text: I can feel it from here. The prototype has proved its worth.

extra.text: Keep it for cold roads. The watch now knows what it must build.
The Lamplighters will remember your service. Ask a guild contact about introductions and workshop commissions.
